items.title: Predator Spyware Compamy Used 15 Zero-Days Since 2021 to Target iOS Users
items.description: A commercial spyware company called Intellexa has exploited 15 zero-day vulnerabilities since 2021 to target iOS and Android users worldwide. The company, known for developing the Predator spyware, continues operations despite being sanctioned by the US government.
